name: leave_schedule
body:
`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `from_date` date NOT NULL,
  `return_date` date NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('pending','approved','rejected') COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `hr_read_status` enum('unread','read') COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unread',
  `ed_read_status` enum('unread','read') COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unread',
  `hr_read_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `ed_read_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `status_changed_by` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `status_changed_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_reply_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_reply_by` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `unread_reply_count` int DEFAULT '0',
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_user_id` (`user_id`),
  KEY `idx_dates` (`from_date`,`return_date`),
  KEY `idx_status` (`status`),
  KEY `idx_hr_read_status` (`hr_read_status`),
  KEY `idx_ed_read_status` (`ed_read_status`),
  KEY `idx_status_changed_by` (`status_changed_by`),
  KEY `idx_last_reply_at` (`last_reply_at`),
  KEY `idx_unread_reply_count` (`unread_reply_count`)

  KEY `user_id` (`user_id`),
  KEY `idx_todo_comments_task` (`task_id`)

name: todo_shares
body:
`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `task_id` int NOT NULL,
  `shared_by` int NOT NULL COMMENT 'User who shared the task',
  `shared_with` int NOT NULL COMMENT 'User who received the task',
  `permission` enum('view','edit','complete') COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT 'view' COMMENT 'Permission level',
  `status` enum('pending','accepted','declined') COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT 'pending' COMMENT 'Share status',
  `shared_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `responded_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `comments` text COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT 'Comments or notes',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `unique_share` (`task_id`,`shared_with`),
  KEY `shared_by` (`shared_by`),
  KEY `idx_todo_shares_task` (`task_id`),
  KEY `idx_todo_shares_with` (`shared_with`,`status`)

name: user_allowed_days

name: user_tasks
body:
`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(300) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `due_date` date NOT NULL,
  `is_completed` tinyint(1) DEFAULT '0',
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `from_datetime` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Start date and time for the task',
  `to_datetime` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'End date and time for the task',
  `description` text COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT 'Detailed task description',
  `priority` enum('Low','Medium','High','Urgent') COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT 'Medium' COMMENT 'Task priority',
  `location` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Task location',
  `is_shared` tinyint(1) DEFAULT '0' COMMENT 'Whether task is shared with others',
  `shared_by` int DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'User who shared this task (if shared)',
  `shared_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'When the task was shared',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_user_tasks_owner` (`user_id`),
  KEY `idx_user_tasks_shared` (`is_shared`,`shared_by`)

name: users
body:
